purpose: Estimate hard graph structural loss gradients, not model quality or final diffusion generation
input_origin: previously viewed saved raw outputs, PS parents continued locally for 32 steps; not pure CE from zero
score: Per-type Gaussian MMD V-statistic on joint log1p relation degrees and typed triangle participation, reference-only sqrt(1+mean(log1p(feature)^2)) scale, bandwidth sqrt(active feature dimension), equal type weight
connectivity: Not included; explicit blind-spot fixture retained
eta: One scalar per saved probability panel; minimize development coordinate-summed empirical gradient variance by -Cov(RF_baseline,control)/Var(control). No search/clipping, zero if control variance zero. Freeze before evaluation.
selected_edges: One edge per nonempty relation x reference-label group using fixed RNG; all methods compared on exactly these coordinates, not a claim about whole-network variance
fixed_support: Exact 0/1 probabilities held fixed and excluded from differentiation; no probability clipping
numerics: CPU float64, independent conditional uniforms, no unknown third-party implementation
stop: Formula/finite/support failure stops affected panel; retain failure, no estimator or target tuning after evaluation
limits: Not original full adaptive-temperature REBAR experiment
No optimizer-state or shared-network response tested
CPU auxiliary Bernoulli graphs are temporary samples, not model-generated T1000 outputs
